description: The Nomad Mk3 frames have stainless steel cable routings for Rohloff hub and for derailleur gears. All of the bosses, seat clamp and new Mk3 Thorn eccentric shell are stainless steel. Complete with ISO rear disc brake mount and adjustable (26”/650B) rim brake studs. The frame features a splitter on the right hand seat stay for a Gates belt. Includes: - 1 1/8" (28.6mm) Orbit XL2 threadless headset - 27.2mm Alloy micro adjust seat post (complete with shim) - Eccentric and screws - CNC Derailleur hanger - CNC Blanking insert (for when derailleur hanger isn't required) Does Not Include: - Fixing screws - Bottom bracket - M5 to M6 Stainless dropout adaptors (SJSC Item 11703) - Dropout adaptor with heavy kick stand mount (SJSC Item 49687) Please Note: These frames require the purchase of a suitable fork (make sure you choose the correct offset for the frame; A, B or C): A = 48mm - suitable for: 55L, 58L, 61S, 61L B = 53mm - suitable for: 47S/T, 50L, 52L, 58S C = 60mm - suitable for: 40S/T, 50S, 52S, 55S - 650B / 26 Inch Thorn Nomad Mk3 Steel Fork - 700c / 650B / 26 Inch Thorn Mk3 Steel Disc Fork Tube Diameters; - Seat Tube: 31.8mm - Top Tube: 31.8mm - Down Tube: 34.9mm - Seat Stays: 19mm We highly recommend that customers add SJSC Item 23407 Frame Workshop Prep (includes all threads tapped and stainless bolts fitted for racks, mudguards and bottle bosses). If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Please note that we no longer have an open showroom.
